# Sunbelt Rentals to Announce Second Quarter Fiscal Year 2027 Results on December 8, 2026


November 11, 2026 4:05pm EST[Download as PDF](https://ir.sunbeltrentals.com/_assets/_47323e71a025ec6639a9b49f0ae6d96d/sunbeltrentals/news/2026-11-11_Sunbelt_Rentals_to_Announce_Second_Quarter_Fiscal__171.pdf)


FORT MILL, S.C.--(BUSINESS WIRE)-- Sunbelt Rentals Holdings, Inc. (NYSE: SUNB; LSE: SUNB) (“the company”), a leader in the equipment rental industry, today announced it will hold its second quarter fiscal year 2027 results call on Tuesday, December 8, 2026, at 8:30 a.m. ET.


The call will be webcast live at[ir.sunbeltrentals.com](http://ir.sunbeltrentals.com/) and a replay will be available shortly after the call concludes.


The company’s second quarter fiscal year 2027 results press release will be posted on the company’s investor relations website at[ir.sunbeltrentals.com](http://ir.sunbeltrentals.com/) prior to the call.


**About Sunbelt Rentals Holdings, Inc.**


Sunbelt Rentals Holdings, Inc., operating primarily as Sunbelt Rentals, is a leading global provider of rental equipment and services based in Fort Mill, S.C. Our passionate, customer-centric team of 26,000 employees combines execution-focused resolve with Sunbelt Rentals’ innovative array of rental solutions across a vast network of over 1,600 locations and with a fleet of assets exceeding $20 billion. Sunbelt Rentals is committed to delivering unrivaled quality and support for its customers across an increasingly diverse array of industries, project types and end markets, including construction, live events, maintenance and countless emerging applications ranging from small-scale developments to mega projects.
